class.name: viam_trajex_moveit/AddTrajexTotgTimeParameterization
class.description: Time parameterization with trajex's time-optimal trajectory generation, configured by trajex's own parameters under trajex.totg.

class.name: viam_trajex_moveit/AddTrajexTotgTimeParameterizationCompat
